(Levart_Photographer/Unsplash) Summary * OpenAI will provide $1 billion in subsidized access to its Daybreak cybersecurity models, training and technical support over the next six months. * The program prioritizes critical infrastructure, governments, banks, nonprofits and open-source maintainers, a category that could include teams securing cryptocurrency and blockchain software. * The initiative follows OpenAI’s disclosure that its Astra model can autonomously find unknown software flaws and create working exploits, as cryptocurrency companies seek access to advanced artificial intelligence tools for defense. OpenAI said Thursday it will [provide $1 billion in subsidized access](https://openai.com/index/daybreak-for-frontline-defenders/) to its cybersecurity models over the next six months, helping organizations build defenses against AI-enabled attacks, including potential “zero-day” exploits from future models such as Astra. Zero-day exploits take advantage of previously hidden software flaws before developers have time to fix them.
